--- title: "06 — Where and among which taxa vent functions are expressed" subtitle: "Frenemies euk metaT — curated grain 4, vent sample units" author: "Hu Lab" date: last-modified format: html: toc: true toc-depth: 2 code-fold: show df-print: paged --- # Questions For every **vent-associated KO** (detected in ≥ 30% of vent units, i.e. ≥ 4 of 13; the universe and habitat classes come from 05): * **A. Where is it expressed?** Vent units, vent fields, and whether it is also in background seawater (`habitat_class` from 05). * **B. Among which taxa?** The class-level (grain 4) taxa that carry it, counted at each rank of the curated taxonomy, and the deepest rank all contributing taxa share (`span_rank`). Average taxonomic distinctness (Δ+) tests whether the contributing taxa are more clustered than a random draw of the same size. * **C. Where × who.** Are field-restricted or vent-only functions carried by narrower lineages? * **D. KEGG level-B composition** of each span class: the blind, trend-reporting view. * **E. Heterotrophy panel**: the question-driven view. Which taxa carry each panel KO, and which taxa co-express the most heterotrophy subcategories. **Rules** (`config/params.yml`, shared with 05, 05b and 07). Span rank and the taxon × KO contributing-taxon pairs are computed once, in 05b, and read here (2026-10-13); 06 adds field span, Δ+ and the heterotrophy view. * *Detected* in a unit: ≥ 1 scaledTPM and ≥ 10 per million of the unit's retained expression. * *Contributing taxon*: a class-level taxon whose taxon × KO pair is detected in ≥ `pair_min_units` (2) vent units. Presence/absence only; these are compositional data, so a contributing taxon is a taxon whose share of that KO clears detection, not a count of cells. * *Span rank* (lowest common ancestor of the contributing taxa, conservative): **class** = one class-level taxon; **phylum** = one curated phylum; **supergroup** = one curated supergroup; **cross-supergroup** otherwise. A contributing taxon not resolved at a rank (an "(unres.)" class or an "-Unannotated" phylum) caps the span at the next coarser rank. Syndiniales is a phylum-level group, separate from Dinophyta (02 curation). * *Δ+* (Clarke & Warwick 1998, *J Appl Ecol* 35:523–531; `vegan::taxondive`): mean rank distance between contributing-taxon pairs over supergroup / phylum / class. Its expected value does not depend on the number of contributing taxa, only its SD does, so `dplus_z = (Δ+ − E[Δ+]) / SD` compares KOs with different contributing-taxon counts on one scale. The conservative rule above is applied here too: unresolved classes and unannotated phyla never count as shared. # Set up ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} source(if (file.exists("_setup.R")) "_setup.R" else "scripts/_setup.R") ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} FIELDS_IN_SCOPE <- c("Gorda Ridge", "Von Damm", "Piccard") CHOSEN_DEPTH <- 4 MIN_TPM <- params$detect_min_tpm MIN_PER_MILLION <- params$detect_min_per_million OCC_MIN <- params$occupancy_min_frac PAIR_MIN_UNITS <- params$pair_min_units N_PERM <- 9999 HABITAT_TABLE <- "output-tables/05_ko_habitat_class.csv" # from 05 TAXON_TABLE <- "output-tables/05_taxon_habitat.csv" # from 05 SPAN_TABLE <- "output-tables/05b_ko_span_by_habitat.csv" # from 05b (vent rows used) PAIR_TABLE <- "output-tables/05b_carrier_pairs.csv.gz" # from 05b SPAN_SENS_TABLE <- "output-tables/05b_span_sensitivity.csv" # from 05b HET_REFERENCE <- "data/gene-lists/het_gene_reference.csv" # scripts/00_build_het_gene_reference.R span_levels <- c("class", "phylum", "supergroup", "cross_supergroup", "no_carrier") span_pal <- c(class = "#D55E00", phylum = "#E69F00", supergroup = "#56B4E9", cross_supergroup = "#0072B2", no_carrier = "grey75", below_filter = "grey88", not_detected = "grey97") span_lab <- c(class = "Class-restricted", phylum = "Phylum-restricted", supergroup = "Supergroup-restricted", cross_supergroup = "Cross-supergroup", no_carrier = "No contributing taxon", below_filter = "Below vent filter", not_detected = "Not detected at vents") scale_span <- function(classes = span_levels, aesthetics = "fill", ...) { scale_fill_manual(aesthetics = aesthetics, values = span_pal[classes], limits = classes, labels = span_lab[classes], name = NULL, ...) } ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # built once at the end of 02 (R/load_paired.R) paired <- load_paired(fields = FIELDS_IN_SCOPE, depth = CHOSEN_DEPTH) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` [load_paired] data/processed/paired_L4.RData (built 2026-10-23 09:06; 318,911 rows) ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} vent <- paired |> filter(vent_bin == "Vent") units_vent <- vent |> distinct(unit = sample_unit, vent_bin, field) stopifnot(nrow(units_vent) == 13) ko_hab <- read_csv(HABITAT_TABLE, show_col_types = FALSE) vent_kos <- ko_hab |> filter(habitat_class %in% c("vent_only", "vent_skewed", "shared")) |> pull(ko_id) message(glue("{length(vent_kos)} vent-associated KOs (>= {OCC_MIN * 100}% of vent units)")) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` 853 vent-associated KOs (>= 30% of vent units) ``` ::: ::: # A. Where is each KO expressed? ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ko_vent_unit <- unit_expression(vent, "ko_id", MIN_TPM, MIN_PER_MILLION) ko_where <- field_span(ko_vent_unit |> filter(ko_id %in% vent_kos), units_vent, "ko_id") |> left_join(ko_hab |> select(ko_id, habitat_class, occ_vent, occ_nonvent, mean_share_vent, mean_share_nonvent), by = "ko_id") # 06 recomputes vent detection on its own; it must agree with 05 stopifnot(all(ko_where$n_vent_units == round(ko_where$occ_vent * 13))) ko_where |> count(habitat_class, field_span) |> pivot_wider(names_from = field_span, values_from = n, names_prefix = "fields_", values_fill = 0) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: # B. Among which taxa? Span rank and contributing taxa come from 05b's vent rows, so the pipeline computes them once. In 05b a taxon × KO pair is detected in a unit against the **whole unit's** retained expression (the same denominator as the KO itself), and a contributing taxon is a pair detected in ≥ `pair_min_units` vent units. >SKH: reads 05b instead of recomputing carriers and span (2026-10-13). Re-render 05b first. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} span_vent <- read_csv(SPAN_TABLE, show_col_types = FALSE) |> filter(habitat == "vent") stopifnot(setequal(span_vent$ko_id, vent_kos), !anyDuplicated(span_vent$ko_id), all(span_vent$pair_min_units == PAIR_MIN_UNITS)) # carrier pairs: vent-associated KOs, taxon x KO detected in >= PAIR_MIN_UNITS vent units carriers <- read_csv(PAIR_TABLE, show_col_types = FALSE) |> filter(ko_id %in% vent_kos, n_det_vent >= PAIR_MIN_UNITS) |> transmute(cur_supergroup, cur_phylum, cur_L4, resolved_L4, ko_id, pair_units = n_det_vent, pair_tpm = tpm_vent) # the pair table must reproduce 05b's carrier count for every KO carrier_check <- carriers |> count(ko_id, name = "n_carriers_pairs") |> full_join(select(span_vent, ko_id, n_L4), by = "ko_id") |> mutate(n_carriers_pairs = replace_na(n_carriers_pairs, 0L)) stopifnot(all(carrier_check$n_carriers_pairs == carrier_check$n_L4)) # distinct full lineages per KO (reported, not interpreted: counts resolution differences). # unit_expression() runs on the full vent table so unit totals include every row. lineage_key <- vent |> distinct(full_classification, SUPERGROUP_0, SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM) |> mutate(cur_full = curated_lineage(full_classification, SUPERGROUP_0, SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM, 99)) n_lineages <- vent |> left_join(lineage_key, by = c("full_classification", "SUPERGROUP_0", "SUPERGROUP_PHYLUM")) |> unit_expression(c("cur_full", "ko_id"), MIN_TPM, MIN_PER_MILLION) |> filter(ko_id %in% vent_kos) |> summarise(pair_units = sum(detected), .by = c(cur_full, ko_id)) |> filter(pair_units >= PAIR_MIN_UNITS) |> count(ko_id, name = "n_lineages") ko_span <- ko_where |> left_join(span_vent |> select(ko_id, n_L2, n_L3, n_L4, top_carrier_L4, top_carrier, top_carrier_share, dom_L2, dom_L3, dom_L4, span_rank), by = "ko_id") |> left_join(distinctness(carriers), by = "ko_id") |> left_join(n_lineages, by = "ko_id") |> mutate(n_lineages = replace_na(n_lineages, 0L), span_rank = factor(span_rank, levels = span_levels), dplus_class = case_when(n_L4 == 0 ~ "no_carrier", n_L4 == 1 ~ "single_carrier", dplus_z <= -2 ~ "clustered", dplus_z >= 2 ~ "spread", TRUE ~ "as_random")) ko_span |> count(span_rank) |> mutate(frac = round(n / sum(n), 3)) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} ko_span |> count(span_rank, dplus_class) |> pivot_wider(names_from = dplus_class, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} ko_span |> summarise(n = n(), median_n_L4 = median(n_L4), median_n_lineages = median(n_lineages), median_dom_L4 = median(dom_L4, na.rm = TRUE), .by = span_rank) |> arrange(span_rank) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: > For results: the share of vent-associated KOs at each span rank, and how many contributing-taxon sets are more clustered than chance (`dplus_class == "clustered"`). ## Sensitivity to the contributing-taxon rule Computed in 05b for both habitats; vent rows shown here. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} read_csv(SPAN_SENS_TABLE, show_col_types = FALSE) |> filter(habitat == "vent") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: > For results: do the span-rank fractions hold when a contributing taxon needs 1, 2 or 3 vent units? ## Figure: span rank and Δ+ Panel A: span rank of every vent-associated KO, split by 05 habitat class. Panel B: Δ+ of each KO's contributing-taxon set against its number of contributing taxa; the dashed line is the expectation for random contributing-taxon sets drawn from the vent pool, the band ± 2 SD (the "funnel"). Points below the band have contributing taxa more taxonomically clustered than chance. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} panel_span <- ko_span |> count(habitat_class, span_rank) |> mutate(habitat_class = factor(habitat_class, levels = c("vent_only", "vent_skewed", "shared")), frac = n / sum(n), .by = habitat_class) |> ggplot(aes(x = frac, y = fct_rev(habitat_class), fill = span_rank)) + geom_col(width = 0.65) + geom_text(data = \(d) summarise(d, n = sum(n), .by = habitat_class), aes(x = 1.02, y = fct_rev(habitat_class), label = glue("n = {n}")), inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, size = 3) + scale_span() + scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) + labs(x = "Vent-associated KOs", y = NULL) + theme_classic(base_size = 10) + theme(legend.position = "bottom") + guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2)) funnel <- ko_span |> filter(!is.na(dplus)) |> distinct(n_carriers, edplus, sd_dplus) panel_funnel <- ggplot(filter(ko_span, !is.na(dplus)), aes(n_carriers, dplus)) + geom_ribbon(data = funnel, aes(x = n_carriers, ymin = edplus - 2 * sd_dplus, ymax = pmin(edplus + 2 * sd_dplus, 100)), inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "grey90") + geom_line(data = funnel, aes(n_carriers, edplus), inherit.aes = FALSE, linetype = 2) + geom_point(aes(fill = span_rank), shape = 21, size = 1.8, alpha = 0.8, position = position_jitter(width = 0.04, height = 0, seed = 1)) + scale_span(guide = "none") + scale_x_continuous(trans = "log2") + labs(x = "Contributing taxa (class level, log2)", y = "Average taxonomic distinctness (Δ+)") + theme_classic(base_size = 10) fig_span <- (panel_span | panel_funnel) + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1.2)) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") fig_span # ggsave("figures/06-span.svg", fig_span, width = 10, height = 4.5) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](06-heterotrophy_files/figure-html/fig-span-1.png){#fig-span width=960} ::: ::: # C. Where × who Do narrower contributing-taxon sets go with narrower geography? Both axes rise with how strongly a KO is expressed (a KO with more expression clears detection in more units **and** in more taxa), so the association is tested with expression held constant: span-rank labels are permuted within tertiles of mean vent share, and the table's chi-square statistic is compared with its permutation distribution. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} strat_chisq <- function(x, y, strata, n_perm = N_PERM) { stat <- \(yy) suppressWarnings(unname(chisq.test(table(x, yy))$statistic)) shuffle <- function() { yy <- y for (s in unique(strata)) { i <- which(strata == s) yy[i] <- y[i][sample.int(length(i))] } yy } obs <- stat(y) null <- replicate(n_perm, stat(shuffle())) tibble(chisq = obs, p_perm = (1 + sum(null >= obs)) / (1 + n_perm)) } set.seed(params$seed) ww <- ko_span |> filter(span_rank != "no_carrier") |> mutate(span_rank = droplevels(span_rank), expr_tertile = ntile(mean_share_vent, 3), vent_restricted = if_else(habitat_class == "shared", "shared", "vent_only/skewed")) span_crosstab <- bind_rows( ww |> count(axis = "field_span", level = as.character(field_span), span_rank), ww |> count(axis = "habitat", level = vent_restricted, span_rank)) |> mutate(frac = n / sum(n), .by = c(axis, level)) where_who_tests <- bind_rows( strat_chisq(ww$field_span, ww$span_rank, ww$expr_tertile) |> mutate(axis = "field_span"), strat_chisq(ww$vent_restricted, ww$span_rank, ww$expr_tertile) |> mutate(axis = "habitat")) span_crosstab |> select(-n) |> pivot_wider(names_from = span_rank, values_from = frac, values_fill = 0) |> mutate(across(where(is.double), \(x) round(x, 3))) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} where_who_tests ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: > For results: whether span rank shifts with field span or with vent-only vs. shared, once expression level is held constant. # D. KEGG level-B composition of each span class Each KO is placed in its KEGG BRITE level-B categories (`read_brite_level_b()`, the same map as 04 and 05). A KO in *n* categories counts 1/*n* in each. Composition is over mapped KOs; coverage differs by class, so it is printed and carried in the axis labels. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} brite_map <- read_brite_level_b() core_span <- c("class", "phylum", "supergroup", "cross_supergroup") span_kegg_long <- ko_span |> filter(span_rank %in% core_span) |> transmute(ko_id, span_rank = as.character(span_rank)) |> left_join(brite_map |> select(ko_id, a_description, description, n_cat), by = "ko_id", relationship = "one-to-many") span_coverage <- span_kegg_long |> summarise(n_ko = n_distinct(ko_id), n_mapped = n_distinct(ko_id[!is.na(description)]), .by = span_rank) span_coverage ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} span_kegg <- span_kegg_long |> filter(!is.na(description)) |> summarise(ko_weight = sum(1 / n_cat), .by = c(span_rank, a_description, description)) |> complete(span_rank, nesting(a_description, description), fill = list(ko_weight = 0)) |> left_join(span_coverage, by = "span_rank") |> mutate(pct_of_mapped = 100 * ko_weight / n_mapped) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} span_axis_lab <- span_coverage |> mutate(lab = glue("{span_lab[span_rank]}\nn = {n_ko}\n({n_mapped} mapped)")) |> select(span_rank, lab) |> deframe() fig_span_kegg <- span_kegg |> mutate(span_rank = factor(span_rank, levels = core_span), description = fct_reorder(description, ko_weight, .fun = sum), a_description = str_wrap(a_description, 14)) |> ggplot(aes(span_rank, description, fill = pct_of_mapped)) + geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4) + geom_text(aes(label = if_else(pct_of_mapped >= 1, sprintf("%.0f", pct_of_mapped), "")), size = 2.6) + scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F4F7FB", high = "#1F4E79", name = "% of mapped\nKOs in class") + scale_x_discrete(labels = span_axis_lab, position = "top") + facet_grid(a_description ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") + labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + theme_minimal(base_size = 9) + theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), strip.placement = "outside", strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold", hjust = 1), axis.text.x.top = element_text(size = 7)) fig_span_kegg # ggsave("figures/06-span-kegg.svg", fig_span_kegg, width = 8, height = 7.5) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](06-heterotrophy_files/figure-html/fig-span-kegg-1.png){#fig-span-kegg width=768} ::: ::: > For results: which level-B categories set class- and phylum-restricted KOs apart from cross-supergroup KOs (read with mapped coverage). # E. Heterotrophy panel The panel is compiled once by `scripts/00_build_het_gene_reference.R` and read here and in 07. Rows there are KO × source × pathway; here they are kept long for subcategory membership (a KO in two subcategories counts in both) and collapsed to one row per KO for the KO table. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} het_long <- read_csv(HET_REFERENCE, show_col_types = FALSE) |> filter(!is.na(subcategory)) |> distinct(ko_id, category, subcategory, gene) het_ko <- het_long |> summarise(across(c(category, subcategory, gene), \(x) paste(sort(unique(x)), collapse = " | ")), .by = ko_id) detected_at_vents <- ko_vent_unit |> filter(detected) |> distinct(ko_id) |> pull() het_span <- het_ko |> left_join(ko_span, by = "ko_id") |> mutate(status = case_when(ko_id %in% vent_kos ~ as.character(span_rank), ko_id %in% detected_at_vents ~ "below_filter", TRUE ~ "not_detected"), status = factor(status, levels = c(span_levels, "below_filter", "not_detected"))) het_span |> count(status) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} het_span |> filter(ko_id %in% vent_kos) |> select(ko_id, gene, subcategory, habitat_class, field_span, span_rank, n_L4, dplus_z, top_carrier, top_carrier_share) |> arrange(span_rank, desc(n_L4)) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: ## Which taxa carry each panel KO Each cell is a contributing taxon's share of that KO's contributing-taxon expression at vents. Columns are vent-associated panel KOs grouped by subcategory; rows are contributing taxa grouped by curated group. The bar panel counts the subcategories each taxon carries (module completeness); its label is the taxon's own mean share of vent expression, because a taxon with little expression has less chance of clearing detection for any KO. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} taxon_vent_share <- read_csv(TAXON_TABLE, show_col_types = FALSE) |> select(cur_L4, cur_group, mean_share_vent) het_carriers <- carriers |> filter(ko_id %in% het_ko$ko_id) |> mutate(share_of_ko = pair_tpm / sum(pair_tpm), .by = ko_id) |> left_join(taxon_vent_share, by = "cur_L4") |> mutate(taxon = taxon_label_unique(cur_L4)) het_taxon_ko <- het_carriers |> inner_join(het_long, by = "ko_id", relationship = "many-to-many") |> select(cur_group, cur_L4, taxon, mean_share_vent, category, subcategory, ko_id, gene, pair_units, pair_tpm, share_of_ko) # module completeness: panel subcategories (with >= 1 vent-associated KO) each taxon carries n_subcats_vent <- het_long |> filter(ko_id %in% vent_kos) |> distinct(subcategory) |> nrow() module_completeness <- het_taxon_ko |> summarise(n_subcategories = n_distinct(subcategory), n_het_kos = n_distinct(ko_id), subcategories = paste(sort(unique(subcategory)), collapse = " | "), .by = c(cur_group, cur_L4, taxon, mean_share_vent)) |> mutate(frac_subcategories = n_subcategories / n_subcats_vent) |> arrange(desc(n_subcategories)) module_completeness |> select(-cur_L4) |> head(15) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # does completeness simply follow a taxon's expression share? (detection confound) completeness_vs_share <- cor.test(module_completeness$n_subcategories, module_completeness$mean_share_vent, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE) completeness_vs_share[c("estimate", "p.value")] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` $estimate rho 0.6351662 $p.value [1] 7.242617e-07 ``` ::: ::: > For results: which taxa co-express the most heterotrophy subcategories, read against their expression share; high completeness with a modest share is the stronger case. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} taxon_order <- module_completeness |> mutate(cur_group = factor(cur_group, levels = SUPERGROUP_0_ordering)) |> arrange(cur_group, desc(n_subcategories)) |> pull(taxon) heat_df <- het_taxon_ko |> mutate(taxon = factor(taxon, levels = rev(taxon_order)), gene_short = str_remove(gene, " \\(.*$"), ko_lab = glue("{gene_short} ({ko_id})"), subcategory = str_wrap(subcategory, 14)) panel_heat <- ggplot(heat_df, aes(ko_lab, taxon, fill = share_of_ko)) + geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) + scale_fill_gradient(low = "#FDF3E7", high = "#A04A00", labels = scales::percent, name = "Share of the KO's\ncontributing-taxon expression") + facet_grid(. ~ subcategory, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") + labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + theme_minimal(base_size = 8) + theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5), strip.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0, size = 7)) panel_complete <- module_completeness |> mutate(taxon = factor(taxon, levels = rev(taxon_order))) |> ggplot(aes(n_subcategories, taxon, fill = cur_group)) + geom_col(width = 0.7) + geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(mean_share_vent, accuracy = 0.1)), hjust = -0.15, size = 2.4, colour = "grey30") + scale_fill_manual(values = tax_color_metaT, name = NULL) + scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.3))) + labs(x = "Subcategories carried\n(label: taxon's mean share of vent expression)", y = NULL) + theme_classic(base_size = 8) + theme(axis.text.y = element_blank()) fig_het_taxa <- (panel_heat | panel_complete) + plot_layout(widths = c(4, 1), guides = "collect") fig_het_taxa # ggsave("figures/06-het-taxa.svg", fig_het_taxa, width = 13, height = 8) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](06-heterotrophy_files/figure-html/fig-het-taxa-1.png){#fig-het-taxa width=1248} ::: ::: ## Figure: panel from reference list to vent span ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} funnel_df <- bind_rows( het_span |> mutate(stage = "Panel KOs"), het_span |> filter(status != "not_detected") |> mutate(stage = "Detected at vents"), het_span |> filter(ko_id %in% vent_kos) |> mutate(stage = "Vent-associated")) |> mutate(fill = if_else(stage == "Vent-associated", as.character(status), "below_filter"), stage = factor(stage, levels = rev(c("Panel KOs", "Detected at vents", "Vent-associated")))) |> count(stage, fill) fig_het_funnel <- ggplot(funnel_df, aes(n, stage, fill = fill)) + geom_col(width = 0.65) + geom_text(data = \(d) summarise(d, n = sum(n), .by = stage), aes(n, stage, label = n), inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = -0.25, size = 3) + scale_span(classes = c(span_levels, "below_filter")) + scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) + labs(x = "Heterotrophy panel KOs", y = NULL) + theme_classic(base_size = 10) fig_het_funnel ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](06-heterotrophy_files/figure-html/fig-het-funnel-1.png){#fig-het-funnel width=672} ::: ::: # Write tables ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} write_csv(ko_span, "output-tables/06_ko_span.csv") # read by 07 write_csv(span_crosstab, "output-tables/06_span_crosstab.csv") write_csv(where_who_tests, "output-tables/06_where_who_tests.csv") write_csv(span_kegg,
